subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix message read/pins CLI output renders completely blank tables

question: Should Matrix `readMessages` return deduplicated edited-message payloads to JSON/tool consumers, or should `m.replace` collapse stay display-only while preserving raw timeline-style payloads?
rationale: The blank-table bug is straightforward, but the open comprehensive fix changes Matrix read payload semantics for non-CLI consumers, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical path if Matrix reads should consistently expose final edited messages across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

options.title: Keep Dedup Display-Only
options.body: Land Matrix-local field projection for read and pins, but keep raw read payloads closer to Matrix timeline pages until a separate contract decision is made.

options.title: Split Blank Tables From Dedup
options.body: Fix the formatter-compatible read/pins rows first and track edited-message aggregation as a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99057 as the canonical path if Matrix reads should consistently expose final edited messages across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Matrix plugin/action-boundary and shared formatter history for choosing the payload contract.
